QuestInfo.name: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie
QuestInfo.1: Staff Sergeant Charlie in Orbis asks you to deliver an item to Master Sergeant Fox. He also wants #b8000 Meso#k as an information fee.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Staff Sergeant Charlie his information fee. What was the item he needed delivered to Master Sergeant Fox?

0.0: What? You came all the way to here by #b#p2020003##k's request? I thought I was the only survivor. I knew that nothing can hurt #b#p2020003##k. HAHA!
0.1: It is good to hear that he is alive. So he is working at El Nath huh? Okay... I found #b#t4031049##k and this would be somewhat related to our mission.
0.2: #b#p2020003##k should be waiting for this item. Just pay me an information fee of #b8000 Mesos#k and I will give it to you. Without this item, you won't be able to prove that you met me, so I suggest that you accept this condition.

default.0: Pay me an information fee of #b8000 Mesos#k if you want the item. Without it, you won't be able to prove that you met me. Keep it safe until you deliver it to #b#p2020003##k!
